title: What happens if you connect Windows XP to the Internet in 2024?
summary: Eric Parker connects a fresh Windows XP machine to the internet in 2024 to see how quickly it gets infected with malware. He documents the dangers of running an unpatched legacy OS online.
why: HN uses it as the counterpoint to a story where XP survived online, noting that a directly exposed XP machine is infected within minutes, though some critics say the setup is not representative of typical use.

quote.text: only takes 15 minutes before the first malware appears on it
